shared.authentication: Use your aio-proxy API key as a Bearer token when authentication is enabled.

listModels.title: List models
listModels.summary: Lists the models currently available through aio-proxy.
listModels.description: Lists the models currently available through aio-proxy.
listModels.note: Agent negotiation and client_version catalogs are excluded from this page.

createChatCompletion.title: Create a chat completion
createChatCompletion.summary: Creates a chat completion with the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API.
createChatCompletion.description: Creates a chat completion with the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. Set `stream: true` to receive a streaming response. Requests are parsed against this endpoint's schema. A same-protocol provider with raw capability receives the raw-forwarded request after routing rewrites; cross-protocol and AI SDK providers receive a converted model request, so fields that cannot be represented by the target protocol are not forwarded.

createResponse.title: Create a response
createResponse.description: Creates an OpenAI Responses-compatible result. Set `stream: true` to receive a streaming response. Requests are parsed against this endpoint's schema. A same-protocol provider with raw capability receives the raw-forwarded request after routing rewrites; cross-protocol and AI SDK providers receive a converted model request, so fields that cannot be represented by the target protocol are not forwarded.

createMessage.title: Create a message
createMessage.description: Creates an Anthropic-compatible message. Set `stream: true` to receive a streaming response. Requests are parsed against this endpoint's schema. A same-protocol provider with raw capability receives the raw-forwarded request after routing rewrites; cross-protocol and AI SDK providers receive a converted model request, so fields that cannot be represented by the target protocol are not forwarded.

createCompletion.title: Create a completion
createCompletion.description: Generates legacy text completions. Set stream: true for SSE ending with data: [DONE]. Token-array prompts and provider-specific fields depend on the selected provider; conversion does not promise full upstream compatibility.

createEmbedding.title: Create embeddings
createEmbedding.description: Embeds input text. Numeric token inputs, dimensions and base64 encoding depend on the selected provider and conversion support.

compactResponse.title: Compact a response
compactResponse.summary: Compacts response context through a compatible raw provider.
compactResponse.description: Compacts response context through a compatible raw provider. A nonempty model is required; streaming is not supported.

countMessageTokens.title: Count message tokens
countMessageTokens.summary: Counts tokens for an Anthropic Messages request using the configured token-counting route.
countMessageTokens.description: Counts tokens for an Anthropic Messages request using the configured token-counting route. The returned input_tokens is not a generated message.

generateContent.title: Generate content
generateContent.summary: Generates content using a model from the URL.
generateContent.description: Generates content using a model from the URL. Same-protocol raw forwarding and model conversion support different fields; upstream extensions are not guaranteed on converted requests.

streamGenerateContent.title: Stream content
streamGenerateContent.summary: Streams Gemini content as SSE data frames; use alt=sse.
streamGenerateContent.description: Streams Gemini content as SSE data frames; use alt=sse. The model is selected from the URL. Event payloads follow Gemini content chunks, not OpenAI [DONE] framing.

countContentTokens.title: Count content tokens
countContentTokens.summary: Counts tokens for Gemini contents using the model in the URL.
countContentTokens.description: Counts tokens for Gemini contents using the model in the URL. Returns totalTokens rather than generated content.

embedContent.title: Embed content
embedContent.summary: Embeds text content using the model in the URL.
embedContent.description: Embeds text content using the model in the URL. Only the request shape validated by aio-proxy is described; this is not the complete upstream Gemini API.

batchEmbedContents.title: Batch embed content
batchEmbedContents.summary: Embeds a batch of text content requests.
batchEmbedContents.description: Embeds a batch of text content requests. The URL model governs routing; supported configuration is limited to the parsed fields and provider capability.

createInteraction.title: Create an interaction
createInteraction.description: Creates a Gemini interaction. Set stream: true for SSE. Converted streams use interaction.created, step events, interaction.completed, then event: done with data: [DONE]. Raw upstream streams retain their upstream format.

generateImages.title: Generate images
generateImages.description: Generates images. Defaults to gpt-image-2.5-sunburst when model is absent. n is 1–10 (dall-e-3: 1). Streaming and URL output depend on compatible raw-provider support; model conversion does not support streaming.

editImages.title: Edit images
editImages.summary: Edits images from JSON image_url/file_id sources or multipart uploads.
editImages.description: Edits images from JSON image_url/file_id sources or multipart uploads. For multipart, upload file bytes rather than the example filename. JSON image sources and streaming require compatible raw-provider support; conversion supports uploaded images within its capability limits.

createSpeech.title: Generate speech
createSpeech.description: Returns audio bytes, not JSON. Defaults to tts-1 when model is absent or blank. response_format selects the representation; listed MIME types are examples, not an exhaustive upstream list. stream_format requires compatible raw-provider support.

transcribeAudio.title: Transcribe audio
transcribeAudio.summary: Uploads a multipart file for transcription; filenames in examples stand for uploaded bytes.
transcribeAudio.description: Uploads a multipart file for transcription; filenames in examples stand for uploaded bytes. Defaults to whisper-1. Conversion supports json, text and verbose_json (metadata required); srt, vtt and stream_format=sse require raw-provider support. A stream flag alone does not enable SSE.

translateAudio.title: Translate audio
translateAudio.summary: Translates an uploaded audio file through raw-provider capability only; no model conversion is available.
translateAudio.description: Translates an uploaded audio file through raw-provider capability only; no model conversion is available. Defaults to whisper-1. Output formats and streaming support depend on that provider.

evaluateSystemOne.title: Evaluate questions
evaluateSystemOne.summary: Evaluates a nonempty question map against state.
evaluateSystemOne.description: Evaluates a nonempty question map against state. noul returns a numeric value, choice requires 1–255 criteria, and score requires 2–10 levels. Inputs must be JSON with finite numbers and at most 512 nesting levels; provider evaluation capability is required.

createVideo.title: Create a video
createVideo.summary: Creates a video job through raw video capability using JSON or multipart.
createVideo.description: Creates a video job through raw video capability using JSON or multipart. Defaults to sora-2; prompt must not be blank. Returned jobs are pinned to the caller and provider in this running proxy process. Response fields depend on the upstream provider.

editVideo.title: Edit a video
editVideo.summary: Edits a video via a raw-capable provider with a JSON request and nonblank prompt.
editVideo.description: Edits a video via a raw-capable provider with a JSON request and nonblank prompt. Source acceptance and response job fields depend on the provider; returned jobs use caller/provider pinning.

extendVideo.title: Extend a video
extendVideo.summary: Extends a video via a raw-capable provider using the JSON video-edit request shape.
extendVideo.description: Extends a video via a raw-capable provider using the JSON video-edit request shape. A nonblank prompt is required. Source acceptance and response fields depend on the provider.

remixVideo.title: Remix a video
remixVideo.summary: Remixes a caller-owned pinned job with a nonblank prompt.
remixVideo.description: Remixes a caller-owned pinned job with a nonblank prompt. The job must still be registered in this proxy process; arbitrary upstream job IDs are not accepted. Uses the pinned provider.

retrieveVideo.title: Retrieve a video
retrieveVideo.summary: Retrieves a caller-owned job from its pinned provider.
retrieveVideo.description: Retrieves a caller-owned job from its pinned provider. The in-memory job registration can expire or be lost after proxy restart. Upstream JSON fields are forwarded.

downloadVideo.title: Download video content
downloadVideo.summary: Downloads binary content for a caller-owned pinned job.
downloadVideo.description: Downloads binary content for a caller-owned pinned job. variant is forwarded to the provider. Returned media type depends on the selected content; this is not a JSON response.

deleteVideo.title: Delete a video
deleteVideo.summary: Deletes a caller-owned pinned job through its original provider.
deleteVideo.description: Deletes a caller-owned pinned job through its original provider. Successful status and body are forwarded from upstream; no universal JSON deletion envelope is guaranteed.

createLiveCall.title: Create a live call
createLiveCall.summary: Creates a realtime call from an SDP offer; this is a signaling alias.
createLiveCall.description: Creates a realtime call from an SDP offer; this is a signaling alias. Supports SDP, text, JSON and multipart; the sample SDP is illustrative, not a usable WebRTC offer. An actual offer must come from your client. The answer and Location identify a caller-owned, provider-pinned call.

createRealtime.title: Create realtime signaling
createRealtime.description: Posts a realtime SDP offer. The model is selected from the body/session or the server default. Compatible realtime capability is required. Requests are limited to 16 MiB and identity content encoding. SDP examples are illustrative; obtain a real offer from your client.

createRealtimeCall.title: Create a realtime call
createRealtimeCall.summary: Creates a provider-pinned realtime call from a client SDP offer.
createRealtimeCall.description: Creates a provider-pinned realtime call from a client SDP offer. Successful responses carry the SDP answer and may include a rewritten Location. JSON and multipart forms are also supported; session in multipart is JSON-encoded text. The example SDP is not a working offer.

hangupRealtimeCall.title: Hang up a realtime call
hangupRealtimeCall.summary: Hangs up a caller-owned registered call.
hangupRealtimeCall.description: Hangs up a caller-owned registered call. After upstream success the proxy removes its call record, closes the attached socket, and returns 204 with no body.

attachLiveCall.title: Attach to a live call
attachLiveCall.summary: Upgrades a WebSocket connection to a caller-owned registered call.
attachLiveCall.description: Upgrades a WebSocket connection to a caller-owned registered call. This is HTTP 101 signaling, not an ordinary JSON GET. The original provider/account is retained. Use a WebSocket client; this reference is read-only.

attachRealtimeCall.title: Attach to a realtime call
attachRealtimeCall.summary: Upgrades to a WebSocket sideband for a caller-owned registered call, retaining its original provider/account.
attachRealtimeCall.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket sideband for a caller-owned registered call, retaining its original provider/account. The call must still exist in this proxy process. A normal HTTP GET is not a WebSocket handshake.

connectRealtime.title: Connect realtime WebSocket
connectRealtime.description: Upgrades a WebSocket connection. With call_id it attaches to that caller-owned call; otherwise it establishes a direct realtime connection using model and provider capability. Frames follow the chosen upstream realtime protocol, not SSE or JSON HTTP responses.
